evidence.detail: Merged 2024-11-29, title: 'Skip all playtest cards in cards db, now that Scryfall have given us a way'
Skip all playtest cards in cards db
`if 'playtest' in p.get('promo_types', []): continue` — playtest card 'Pick Your Poison' is excluded entirely from the oracle database, so its mana cost can never appear

triage.notes: Issue was filed 2024-05-16; fix landed 2024-11-29. Issue remains open despite being resolved.
triage.proposed_comment: This was fixed in November 2024 by PR #13378 (commit c9feea8f), which excludes all cards with `promo_types` containing 'playtest' from the oracle database. The playtest 'Pick Your Poison' card no longer exists in our card data, so only the real card's mana cost and image are shown.
